_comment: Feature 090 (nick cross) adoption gate. FROZEN 2026-08-11 BEFORE any paired evaluation was run — no candidate/active metric had been observed at freeze time. The verdict formula is contracts/feature-columns.md '判定式(3 分岐)': ADOPT iff gate.adopted AND subgroup_guard; REJECT if the evaluation completed and that conjunction fails (a CI crossing zero is a REJECT, per the 070 precedent); NO_DECISION ONLY if the evaluation itself cannot run. report.decision is a 073 reference value, never the verdict.

subgroup_guard._comment: Same intersection-union three-way as 069/070 so verdicts stay comparable. adopted requires ALL critical subgroups PASS.

eval_window._comment: Same pre-registered OOS window as 069/070 so this verdict is comparable with the past-market bundles.

arms._comment: drop=nick_cross expands to the two 090 columns, so the baseline arm is features-021 MINUS the nick block = the features-018 input set. Both arms refit per fold (068 contract).

feature_definition._comment: Frozen feature constants (INV-N5). Changing any of these after this freeze invalidates the verdict.
feature_definition.hierarchy: nested partial pooling L0(sire x damsire) -> L1(sire x damsire_line, leave-child-out) -> independence expectation; no hard cell threshold
